name: Count By
description: How many records share each value of a field — tickets per status, orders per country, sign-ups per plan — as a list of { key, count } for a chart, a set of KPI tiles or a summary line.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const counts = new Map(); for (const it of items || []) { const k = it == null ? '' : it[field]; counts.set(k, (counts.get(k) || 0) + 1); } return [...counts].map(([key, count]) => ({ key, count })); })() }}"}]
